review_description: Alan was happy to answer questions multiple times and revise his quote when we decided to change what we wanted. No sales pitch or pushiness, just real info. Alan knows all the regulations and only deals with quality components which means reliability. The installation was very friendly and helpful and all done neatly including some extra changes required to the switchboard to meet new regulations. We already have a solar system Alan put in 9 years ago and it hasn’t missed a beat so after talking to a number of other companies, we decided to go with Alan again as he was able to answer all our questions regarding the setup and use of battery and provides only reliable components. Very happy, would recommend Alectric to anyone.
